messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT: GPU_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION detected in gpu-pool-prod-7. Rapid queue growth since model:v10.0 rollout. Pagering lee_oncall.

lee_oncall: I'm awake, looking at dashboards. Queued requests ~5.2k, p95 latency ~4.6s, error spike 502/503 across multiple routes.

rachel_infra: Autoscaler reports: attempted scale to 180 nodes but blocked by "project.soft_max=150" in autoscaler config. That soft cap appears to have been set yesterday during a config cleanup. Current hard quota at cloud=300 so we could scale if cap removed.

diego_ml: v10.0 went stable ~12m ago. Model telemetry: median context tokens jumped from 1300 -> 7200, kv-cache write amplification x4. Inference time per request up 35%. There's also a new tokenizer normalization change increasing token counts for multi-lingual payloads.

alina_csm: Early CS triage: 9 customers reported increased errors; two reported timeouts on critical flows (checkout). They're asking for hotfix and status.

lee_oncall: Triage steps: 1) remove soft_max override, 2) enable emergency fallback routing to v9.x for user-facing routes, 3) apply temporary request context cap at 10k tokens, 4) pause KV warmup and background churn, 5) open cloud quota ticket as backup.

mara_ops: We have 32 reserved GPUs in eu-west that can be repointed to prod. Can shift in ~6m.

rachel_infra: Removing soft cap now. Command run:
```
redwoodctl autoscaler config unset --project default --key project.soft_max
```
Response: OK. Autoscaler reconciliation triggered.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: model:v10.0 -> stable at 2198764800. Canary passed. No regression alarms configured for memory or context inflation.

diego_ml: From model logs:
```
2026-03-15T19:12:03Z INFO tokens=8300 kv_entries=11200 mem_alloc=58GB
2026-03-15T19:12:23Z WARN kv_cache: prefetch_backlog=1200 evict_rate=0.42
2026-03-15T19:13:11Z ERROR serve: accept failed: queue_full
```
Recommend toggling `MODEL_V10_TOKENIZER_NORMALIZE=false` and disabling `KV_PREFETCH` for v10.0 in-flight.

lee_oncall: Applying context cap rule for prod for 30m to limit user tokens:
```
redwoodctl config set --scope prod --key inference.max_context --value 10000 --ttl 1800
```
Rule active.

rachel_infra: Repointing reserved eu-west GPUs to prod. Command issued. Pool size +32 expected in ~5m.

mara_ops: Done. eu-west reserved reallocated.

alina_csm: Drafted customer note: brief explanation + mitigation steps, estimated recovery 45-90m. Sending to affected accounts now.

diego_ml: Pushing runtime flag changes to v10 canaries to disable tokenizer normalization and kv prefetch. Patch:
```
MODEL_V10_TOKENIZER_NORMALIZE=false
MODEL_V10_KV_PREFETCH=false
```
Rolling to 10% canary.

incident-bot: Alert: canary change deployed at 2198765280. Monitoring for perf improvement.

rachel_infra: Cloud ticket submitted for temp node quota increase to 400 (REQ-2178). Contacted account manager.

lee_oncall: If queues don't drop to <1k in 12m we will rollback v10.0. Diego, what's rollback impact?

diego_ml: Full rollback to v9.3 restores previous tokenizer and disables prefetch. We can do a phased rollback (canary -> 50% -> full) within 25-40m. Need deploy approval.

mara_ops: Finance approval for partner GPU pool obtained. Provisioning +64 GPUs now (spot/hybrid).

rachel_infra: Autoscaler reconciled and began scaling after soft cap removal. Currently at 165 nodes and climbing. Ephemeral partner GPUs gating in.

incident-bot: Impact summary: ~14% of requests failing, high latency for enterprise lanes. No signs of data loss. On-call: lee_oncall. Next update in 10m.

alina_csm: Customers notified: Received mixed feedback, one customer asked for immediate rollback.

lee_oncall: Rolling fallback routing to v9.3 on user-facing routes at 40% to take pressure off v10.0:
```
redwoodctl routing override create --from-route "*/generate" --to-model "v9.3" --percent 40 --reason "emergency pressure relief"
```
Applied.

diego_ml: Canary with flags shows memory usage down 22% and decode time down 18% on canary nodes. Good sign.

rachel_infra: After routing + reserved + partner GPUs, queue length down 56% in 9m. Error rate trending down.

finance-bot: Cost alert: ephemeral partner GPU pool provisioning will incur ~USD 4.2k/hr. Finance approved short-term for incident mitigation.

lee_oncall: Monitoring. If we stabilize, plan: keep v10.0 canaries with flags disabled, run thorough perf tests, then either reintroduce tokenizer change with fixes or rollback fully. Need postmortem owner.

mara_ops: I'll take postmortem coordination once stabilized. Diego to lead technical RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Stabilization achieved. Queue drained to normal thresholds, p95 latency back to SLO after ~37m. Status: mitigated. Follow-up actions queued: postmortem, config audit to prevent accidental soft caps, add memory/context regression alerting to deploy pipeline.

lee_oncall: Handing off to mara_ops at 2198765500. Great job everyone.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: GPU_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION - root cause suspected model tokenizer/context inflation + autoscaler soft cap. Severity P1, total duration ~42m, affected customers: 9 with degraded service. Postmortem scheduled.
